CS 121

CS 121 / IN4MATX 141 is UCI's information retrieval course: how search engines collect, process, index, and rank web documents.

This page collects week-by-week notes for classmates who want a structured review of text processing, the web graph, SEO and spam, web crawling, the ethics and law around collecting web data, and text processing and term-document matrices.

CS 121 / IN4MATX 141 是 UCI 的信息检索课程,讲搜索引擎如何收集、处理、索引网页文档并为其排序。

这个页面汇总按周整理的课程笔记,方便同学回顾文本处理、网络图、SEO 与垃圾信息、网络爬虫、采集网页数据涉及的伦理与法律问题,以及文本处理与词项-文档矩阵。

/
Topic 1

Search Engines & the Web

What information retrieval is and its task types, why web search engines matter (the ad business, the job market), database vs search engines, relevance and retrieval models, classic IR vs web IR, the search workflow and engine architecture, the web graph and its evolution, user needs, queries and behavior, ad pricing (CPM, CPC, CPA) and click fraud, SEO, keyword stuffing, cloaking, doorway pages, link spam and User-Agent spoofing, the war on spam, and what ranking really uses (the Yandex leak).

Last edited on November 25, 2026

AvailableOpen →
Topic 2

Web Crawling

Flavors of web data collection (dumps, URL downloads, web APIs, crawling), URIs, URLs and URNs and URL anatomy, the basic crawl algorithm and frontier, robots.txt and sitemaps, politeness, DNS and crawl-time estimates, crawler traps, duplicates, noise, deep web and client-side scripting, freshness, age and expected age, distributed, focused and desktop crawling, document feeds (RSS, WebSub), and ethics, privacy, copyright, fair use and legal cases.

Last edited on November 25, 2026

AvailableOpen →
Topic 3

Document Conversion, Storage & Duplicates

Converting documents to text, character encodings (ASCII, Unicode, UTF-8/UTF-16/UTF-32), storing documents (TREC Web format, compression, BigTable), exact duplicates (checksums, CRC), near duplicates (n-gram fingerprints, Simhash), and removing page noise (content blocks, document slope curve, DOM).

Last edited on November 25, 2026

AvailableOpen →
Topic 4

Text Processing

Corpus and text processing pipeline, tokenization (lexer, early 3+ alphanumeric rule, hyphens, apostrophes, numbers, periods, TREC rules), text statistics and Zipf's law (AP89, hapax legomena), stopping and stopwords, stemming (suffix-s, Porter, Porter2, dictionary stemmers, Krovetz, false positives and negatives), phrases (POS tagging, word n-grams, Google n-grams), document structure and markup, and anchor text.

Last edited on November 25, 2026

AvailableOpen →
Topic 5

Inverted Indexes & Index Construction

Why a term-document incidence matrix does not scale, the inverted index (dictionary, postings, docIDs, document frequency), the indexer's token-sort-merge steps and the in-memory BuildIndex, postings with counts, positions, extents and scores, biword and positional indexes for phrase queries, hardware limits and disk seeks, blocked external construction with partial indexes and multi-way merging, index engineering (index the index, seek, lexicon, auxiliary structures), MapReduce distributed indexing, and index updates with delete lists.

Last edited on November 25, 2026

AvailableOpen →
Topic 6

Retrieval Models: Boolean, tf-idf & Vector Space

Boolean retrieval (exact match, incidence-matrix bit vectors, WestLaw, feast or famine), retrieval models and the abstract model of ranking, Jaccard, count vectors and bag of words, tf and log-frequency weighting, idf and tf-idf, the vector space model (cosine similarity, length normalization, the CosineScore algorithm), SMART notation and lnc.ltc, zone and field indexes, query term proximity, query parsers, aggregate scores and the complete search system.

Last edited on November 25, 2026

AvailableOpen →
Topic 7

Query Processing & Efficient Top-K

How a search engine answers a query fast: merging postings for AND (skip pointers, query term order by document frequency), document-at-a-time vs term-at-a-time scoring, conjunctive processing, threshold methods and MaxScore, early termination, the heap for top-K selection, inexact top-K (index elimination, champion lists, static quality g(d) and the net score, high/low lists, impact-ordered postings, tiered indexes), distributed query evaluation and query caching.

Last edited on November 25, 2026

AvailableOpen →
Topic 8

Link Analysis: HITS & PageRank

Why links are evidence, HITS hubs and authorities (root and base sets, the connectivity server, the iteration, topic drift), PageRank's random surfer and teleporting, the PageRank formula by iteration and in matrix form, and how PageRank is used in a real engine.

Last edited on November 25, 2026

AvailableOpen →
Topic 9

Search Engine Evaluation

How users judge a search engine (relevance, trust, duplicates, readability, speed, F-shape reading, precision vs recall, interface and tools), effectiveness vs efficiency vs cost, test collections (CACM, AP, GOV2, TREC topics), relevance judgments, pooling, query logs and clickthrough data (click bias, Skip Above and Skip Next, click deviation), and precision, recall, fallout and classification errors with a worked example.

Last edited on November 25, 2026

AvailableOpen →
话题 1

搜索引擎与 Web

什么是信息检索及其任务类型，为何网络搜索引擎重要（广告业务与就业市场），数据库引擎与搜索引擎的区别，相关性与检索模型，经典 IR 与 Web IR，搜索流程与搜索引擎架构，网络图及其演化，用户需求、查询与行为，广告定价（CPM、CPC、CPA）与点击欺诈，SEO、关键词堆砌、伪装、过渡页、链接垃圾与 User-Agent 伪造，垃圾信息之战，以及排名究竟用了什么（Yandex 泄露）。

话题 5

倒排索引与索引构建

为何词项-文档关联矩阵无法扩展；倒排索引（词典、postings、docID、文档频率）；索引器的词元-排序-合并步骤与内存中的 BuildIndex；带计数、位置、区段与分数的 postings；用于短语查询的双词索引与位置索引；硬件限制与磁盘寻道；带部分索引与多路合并的分块外部构建；索引工程（为索引建索引、seek、词汇表、辅助结构）；MapReduce 分布式索引；以及带删除列表的索引更新。

话题 6

检索模型：布尔、tf-idf 与向量空间

布尔检索（精确匹配、词项-文档关联矩阵上的关联向量、WestLaw、饥荒或盛宴）；检索模型与排序的抽象模型；Jaccard、计数向量与词袋模型；tf 与对数频率加权；idf 与 tf-idf；向量空间模型（余弦相似度、长度归一化、CosineScore 算法）；SMART 记法与 lnc.ltc；区域与字段索引；查询词项邻近；查询解析器；聚合分数，以及完整的搜索系统。

话题 7

查询处理与高效 Top-K

搜索引擎如何快速回答查询：为 AND 合并 postings（跳表指针，按 df 排定查询词项顺序）、按文档处理与按词项处理两种打分方式、合取处理、阈值方法与 MaxScore、提前终止、用堆选出前 K 个、近似的前 K 个（索引剪枝、冠军列表、静态质量 g(d) 与净得分、高低列表、按影响排序的 postings、分层索引）、分布式查询求值与查询缓存。

Inverted Index, Index Construction

Scaling the Index, Query Processing, tf-idf

The Vector Space Model and Cosine Ranking

Documents and queries as tf-idf vectors, why Euclidean distance fails, cosine similarity and length normalization, the CosineScore algorithm, tf-idf variants and SMART notation (lnc.ltc), an aggregated scoring function, and faster ranking: top-K with a heap, inexact top K and index elimination.
